content.text: Louisville, KY Event Dates Apr 30, 2026 - May 3, 2026 Country Prices Starting at Overview Derby Travel Packages Kentucky Derby Experiences FAQs Derby Tickets 2026 Kentucky Derby Tickets Join Bucket List Events for our three-night 2026 Kentucky Derby tickets packages in Louisville, offering an amazing weekend of big hats, parties, people watching, high fashion, bourbon sipping, and of course, Derby tickets to watch the thrilling horse races. Churchill Downs has hosted the Kentucky Derby since 1875, which makes it the longest continuously running sporting event in American history. Bucket List Events has been hosting guests since 2004, making us your most trusted travel partner in Louisville.The Kentucky Derby is often called the most exciting two minutes in sports, but don’t let the nickname fool you. The Derby is an all-day affair, and, truth be told, a complete 2026 Kentucky Derby experience takes about three full days. We offer Kentucky Derby tickets packages that include convenient hotel accommodations, Buffalo Trace distillery tours, race day transportation, and a range of options for 2026 Kentucky Derby tickets. You might also choose to attend the exclusive Barnstable Brown Gala, named by Conde Nast as one of the Top 10 parties in the world.Our 2026 Kentucky Derby ticket packages will treat you to the experience of a lifetime. And there’s no time like the present to check this world-renowned event off your bucket list. JOIN US!Check In: Thursday, April 30, 2026 Check Out: Sunday, May 3, 2026Derby Day: Saturday, May 2, 2026 What’s included? Our Kentucky Derby Ticket Packages give you the experience you’ve been dreaming of your entire life. All packages include the following: Three-night hotel stay: Select from 3 great hotel choices Reserved seats for the 152nd Kentucky Derby, featuring all-inclusive food and drinks (alcohol included). Click to view seating options and pricing. Experience Kentucky Tour: A tour and tasting at Buffalo Trace distillery followed by a stop at Lane's End horse farm, with lunch included Kentucky Derby welcome gift Shuttle service to and from Churchill Downs on race day Optional experience add-ons On-site assistance from Derby experts Book with Confidence Policy included All-inclusive pricing: No added fees at checkout Accessibility: We can help you navigate the process from parking passes to accessible seating options 2026 Kentucky Derby Packages Now Available Find the Derby package that best fits your expectations Kentucky Derby Hotel Options Hotel rooms in Louisville during the Kentucky Derby can be hard to find, but never fear, we have your spot reserved at either the Holiday Inn Express, the Galt Hotel or the Grady Hotel in the heart of downtown Louisville next to 4th Street Live, and within walking distance to all the top Louisville restaurants and attractions. We have arranged roundtrip, convenient shuttles for all guests between their hotel and Churchill Downs on Derby Day, so all your transportation needs are covered. Choose the experience that is right for you!About the Holiday Inn Express, Louisville: Stay in downtown Louisville and avoid paying a premium for larger hotels during the Derby. Combining modern hotel amenities with Southern hospitality, guests at the Holiday Inn Express will enjoy daily breakfast and convenient access to attractions on Main Street, like the Louisville Slugger museum.About the Galt House Hotel, Louisville: Stay in the heart of downtown at Louisville’s only waterfront hotel along the banks of the Ohio River. Located just steps from 4th Street Live and all the top Louisville attractions, the Galt House is conveniently located next to the KFC YUM! Center and close to the Kentucky International Convention Center. Churchill Downs is just 15-minutes away. Start your trip in style on the 25th floor at Swizzle, the city’s most picturesque dining spot, and enjoy prime steaks, cool cocktails, and panoramic views.About the Grady Hotel, Louisville: Blending modern amenities with the spirit of Kentucky, this new property offers a bold and distinctive stay in downtown Louisville. Just steps from Whiskey Row and less than 5 miles from Churchill Downs, guests can enjoy all that downtown Louisville has to offer. The Grady Hotel offers a boutique feel with modern rooms, and exceptional service. Package Experience Highlights We offer Kentucky Derby ticket packages that include convenient hotel accommodations, tour of Buffalo Trace distillery and Lane’s End horse farm, race day transportation, and a number of Derby ticket options for you to choose from. You will also have the ability to enjoy exclusive parties and galas and upgrade your Derby ticket to include a VIP race day experience. Let Bucket List Events treat you to the experience of a lifetime. Learn more about all of our package experiences below. The Derby Day ExperienceYour Derby experience will be something you’ll be talking about for years to come and a memory you’ll never forget. Every package includes a Derby ticket so you can experience the most exciting event in sports up close and personal. Choose your ticket when you check out.  learn more. Experience Bourbon and Horse Country with our toursLouisville is located in the heart of bourbon and horse country. It would be appropriate, then, to experience the area and all the cultural richness it has to offer. Our guests can tour Buffalo Trace distillery and Lane's End horse farm. learn more Barnstable Brown GalaThe Barnstable Brown Kentucky Derby Eve Gala is internationally recognized as the premier Kentucky Derby gala. The celebrity-packed gala benefits the Barnstable Brown Diabetes and Obesity Research Center at the University of Kentucky. Past guests include Boys II Men, Kid Rock, Tom Brady, Jennifer Nettles, Aaron Rodgers, Janet Jackson and more. This is an optional add-on experience to any package. learn more. Turf Club Seat – VIP Track ExperienceEnjoy an amazing Derby Day experience above the track overlooking the finish line and experience gourmet food and a premium open bar inside the Turf Club. This is one of the most sought-after experiences and the most requested location at Churchill Downs. The Turf Club is known to host celebrities every year. The Turf Club seat is our VIP experience and offers an indoor seat in this exclusive area of Churchill Downs. (no outside seating). learn more. Kentucky Derby Tickets All of our Kentucky Derby packages include Kentucky Derby tickets. We believe that everyone should experience the Kentucky Derby at least once in their lifetime so we offer package options that fit a variety of interests, needs, and budgets. All packages are priced per person and based on the Kentucky Derby ticket level you choose.Kentucky Derby tickets are complicated and the process of choosing where to sit can be overwhelming. There are many options for admission with the most affordable tickets starting at the general admission level, increasing to tens of thousands of dollars for VIP Boxes. Our packages offer a few select sections to choose from, all giving you that Derby Day experience you have been dreaming of. Whether or not you choose to upgrade your Derby day experience by adding a Turf Club Pass, that is up you.For a better understanding about Kentucky Derby tickets and a detailed breakdown of the different options at Churchill Downs, click here. Our team can also make recommendations based on your interests and budget. Contact us today and we will be more than happy to talk with you. Attending the Kentucky Derby is a lifelong dream for many sports fans and avid travelers. Whatever your reason for attending this event may be, we are happy you’ll be joining us in Kentucky. From the southern fashion and star-studded parties, to the history of witnessing the “greatest two minutes in sports,” you are guaranteed to experience an event weekend like no other. We have compiled a list of frequently asked questions and helpful articles that will shed light on some of the most popular questions and curiosities. Can I visit all areas of Churchill Downs? Do you have any insider tips that will make my experience better? Find out the answers to these questions and more in our FAQ section.
